facts.fact: The bidding document states that NITA's two national data centres, in Accra and Kumasi, operational over the past 10 years, serve as central hubs for the Government of Ghana's IT operations and provide data storage, with about 90% of capacity used; the Accra core network backbones all government network services.

The bidding document states that NITA's secondary national data centre in Kumasi, a Huawei IDS1000 containerised facility of 42 cabinets, is one of the two government data centres hosting the Government of Ghana's IT operations (as_of is the document's published date as it gives no other).

systems.owner: National Information Technology Agency (NITA), under the Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations

note: Refresh tender (World Bank financed); no Tier rating or statement that space is rented to others; Accra expansion floor and Kumasi upgrade are planned works.
